# UX Spec: [Flow/screen] (UX-NNN)

> Feature: F-NNN · Design system: `docs/specs/design-system.md` · Date:

## 1. User goal and context
Who, why they came, device (mobile-first?), frequency of use.

## 2. Flow
Steps with branches (text diagram or mermaid); entry/exit points.

## 3. Screens
For each: purpose, composition (design-system components), information hierarchy, actions (primary/secondary), navigation.

## 4. States
Empty · Loading (skeleton) · Error (text + action) · Success · Partial data · Offline · No permission.

## 5. UI copy
Table key → text (per locale), tone, validation errors.

## 6. Accessibility
Focus order, aria names, live-region announcements, contrast, target sizes, reduced motion.

## 7. Responsive behaviour
Breakpoints/container queries; what changes on narrow screens; safe areas.

## 8. UX metrics
What we measure (step success, time, drop-off) — analytics events.

## 9. Open questions
